description: Adult female cartoon voice actress performing a bossy know-it-all playground girl for an adult animated horror-comedy. Exaggerated high, sharp, shrill and slightly squeaky nasal tone with a smug sing-song lilt and deadpan sarcastic punchlines, in the spirit of crude adult TV cartoons. Fast confident delivery. Native Slovak speaker, precise articulation, every word understandable. Clearly different from a raspy brat and a timid wobbly voice. Clean dry studio recording, no music or background.
text: Tieto čiary sú kolesá pohrebáka. Šiel ku kostolu, tak som mu nakreslila odbočku do žihľavy. Chlap ju ignoroval. Nula bodov za spoluprácu, hajzel. Je vysušená a okrúhla ako žetón. Obaľ ju zlatým obalom od čokolády. Karolovi hráči ich nechávajú pri automatoch v starej herni. Len pozor: alobal sa môže zachytiť v kontaktoch. Ocko tak raz vyhral hasičov.
